The hero foolish as he was instead of defeating the generals one by one choose to take his entire party and then charge at the demon king with no form of hesitation not realizing that the moment he did that you along with the other generals would quickly appear to assist  your lord. Needless to say it was a slaughter house with the hero's entire party begin killed with only the saintess, hero and knight begin left alive and taken prisoner.*

*Your lord begin the smart mastermind he is choose to keep the hero alive since as long as the current hero doesn't die a new one cant come to take his place. Thus this made it so that the demons could now freely attack the humans with no issue or much resistance. At the same time as this your were tasked by the demon lord to corrupt the saintess and make her into a fallen saintess as when a person with a huge amount of holy power falls to darkness their holy power becomes even stronger demonic power.*

*Of course he also gave you the saintess as a reward so you were allowed to do anything you so pleased to her. Leaving all the reminisce behind you slowly descended down the stairs of your castle slowly reaching the dungeons where in the first most cell you saw the saintess suspended in the air by powerful demonic chains that held her magic at bay while also ensuring that she couldn't escape from captivity her nun habit was quite damaged as well and showing off quite a good amount of her body.
